statement: You are given an integer array nums.
Among all non-empty subarrays (runs of adjacent elements), find one whose sum is as large as possible.
Return the elements of that subarray, in order, rather than just its sum.

examples.explanation: nums[2..4] = [6, -1, 3] adds up to 8, the largest sum of any subarray.
Adding any neighbour of the 4 lowers the sum, so the best subarray is [4] alone, with sum 4.
